## About
Tom's Auto Body was started by our father, Tom Ocano. He had spent years working as a painter for dealerships around the Valley, and with a growing family to take care of, he decided to go into business for himself. We're still in the same spot today.
Dad has since retired and passed the shop on to his sons, Art and Ron. We keep it family-operated because we love the work of repairing today's vehicles, and we like getting to know the people who bring their cars to us.
Our technicians combine solid craftsmanship with modern equipment to bring your car back to its pre-accident condition. Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 81 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs that restore your vehicle to its pre-accident condition.
- Auto painting: Painting work backed by computerized paint matching.
- Computerized paint matching
- Paintless dent repair
- Hail damage repair
- Bumper repair
- Unibody and frame repair
- Plastic welding
- Windshield replacement
- Window regulators
- Secure storage
- Fleet repair: Fleet accounts are available for businesses.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on E Buckeye Rd, about a mile from Sky Harbor Airport and south of downtown Phoenix.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We offer direct repair for most insurance companies.

Q: How do I get around while my car is in the shop?
A: We offer a free shuttle.
